info.title: RentCast Universal API
info.description: Search property records, valuations, listings, and market statistics

get.description: Retrieves market statistics from RentCast for a ZIP code.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: zipCode
parameters.description: A valid 5-digit US zip code.

schema.description: A valid 5-digit US zip code.

parameters.name: dataType
parameters.description: The type of aggregate market data to retrieve.

schema.description: The type of aggregate market data to retrieve.

parameters.name: historyRange
parameters.description: The number of months of historical market data to include.

parameters.name: fields

get.description: Finds property records in RentCast by address or area.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name used to search for property records in a specific city.

schema.description: City name used to search for property records in a specific city.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-character state abbreviation used to search for property records in a specific state.

schema.description: Two-character state abbreviation used to search for property records in a specific state.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Full street address used to search for a specific property or a circular area when paired with radius.

schema.description: Full street address used to search for a specific property or a circular area when paired with radius.

parameters.name: zipCode
parameters.description: 5-digit zip code used to search for property records in a specific area.

schema.description: 5-digit zip code used to search for property records in a specific area.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the circular search area when searching by coordinates.

schema.description: Latitude of the circular search area when searching by coordinates.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the circular search area when searching by coordinates.

schema.description: Longitude of the circular search area when searching by coordinates.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in miles used with address or coordinates to search within a circular area.

schema.description: Radius in miles used with address or coordinates to search within a circular area.

parameters.name: includeTotalCount
parameters.description: When enabled, RentCast returns the total number of matching property records in the X-Total-Count response header.

schema.description: When enabled, RentCast returns the total number of matching property records in the X-Total-Count response header.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: An RSQL expression used to filter the results.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
